llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究AlSi10Mg点阵结构的力学行为，但材料并非生物医用，且未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能，对生物医学AM方向参考价值有限。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no fatigue testing, and material (AlSi10Mg) is not biocompatible for implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制造AlSi10Mg点阵结构的力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备不同点阵结构并进行静态压缩实验。
summary_zh.result: 获得了不同结构类型的力学响应和失效模式。
summary_zh.validation: 压缩实验验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: This paper investigates the mechanical behavior of AlSi10Mg lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Various lattice designs were manufactured via SLM and subjected to quasi-static compression tests.
summary_en.result: The mechanical properties and failure mechanisms were characterized for different lattice topologies.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests were conducted to validate the mechanical performance.

papers.title: Heart Failure is Associated with Early Medical and Surgery-Related Complications Following Total Hip Arthroplasty: A Propensity-Scored Analysis
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, MedStar Union Memorial Hospital, Baltimore, Maryland, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Sean B. Sequeira
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, MedStar Union Memorial Hospital, Baltimore, Maryland, USA

llm.relevance_to_user: 与髋关节植入物与股骨柄方向的生物力学建模无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on clinical complications in heart failure patients after THA, with no biomechanical modeling, FEA, stress/strain analysis, or implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究心力衰竭对全髋关节置换术后并发症的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用倾向评分匹配分析全国住院患者样本数据。
summary_zh.result: 心力衰竭患者术后早期医疗和手术并发症风险增加。
summary_zh.validation: 基于大型数据库的回顾性队列研究。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether heart failure increases the risk of early medical and surgery-related complications following total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A propensity score-matched analysis was conducted using a national inpatient sample database.
summary_en.result: Heart failure patients had significantly higher rates of early postoperative complications compared to controls.
summary_en.validation: Retrospective cohort study with propensity score matching to reduce confounding.

papers.title: Use of CGF in Oral and Implant Surgery: From Laboratory Evidence to Clinical Evaluation.
papers.abstract: Edentulism is the condition of having lost natural teeth, and has serious social, psychological, and emotional consequences. The need for implant services in edentulous patients has dramatically increased during the last decades. In this study, the effects of concentrated growth factor (CGF), an autologous blood-derived biomaterial, in improving the process of osseointegration of dental implants have been evaluated. Here, permeation of dental implants with CGF has been obtained by using a Round up device. These CGF-coated dental implants retained a complex internal structure capable of releasing growth factors (VEGF, TGF-β1, and BMP-2) and matrix metalloproteinases (MMP-2 and MMP-9) over time. The CGF-permeated implants induced the osteogenic differentiation of human bone marrow stem cells (hBMSC) as confirmed by matrix mineralization and the expression of osteogenic differentiation markers. Moreover, CGF provided dental implants with a biocompatible and biologically active surface that significantly improved adhesion of endothelial cells on CGF-coated implants compared to control implants (without CGF). Finally, data obtained from surgical interventions with CGF-permeated dental implants presented better results in terms of optimal osseointegration and reduced post-surgical complications. These data, taken together, highlight new and interesting perspectives in the use of CGF in the dental implantology field to improve osseointegration and promote the healing process.

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effect of concentrated growth factor (CGF) coating on dental implants for improving osseointegration.
summary_en.method: Dental implants were permeated with CGF using a Round up device, and the release of growth factors and matrix metalloproteinases was measured.
summary_en.result: CGF-coated implants induced osteogenic differentiation of hBMSCs and improved endothelial cell adhesion, with better clinical osseointegration and fewer complications.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and clinical surgical interventions.

papers.title: Outcomes of novel 3D-printed fully porous titanium cup and a cemented highly cross-linked polyethylene liner in complex and revision total hip arthroplasty.
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: A novel fully porous acetabular titanium shell has been designed to reduce stiffness mismatch between bone and implant and promote osseointegration in complex (cTHA) and revision total hip arthroplasty (rTHA). A highly cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) liner is cemented within the cup to reduce wear rates and increase survivorship. This study reported the outcomes of an XLPE liner cemented into a novel 3D-printed fully porous cup in cTHA and rTHA. METHODS: Presented was a multicenter retrospective review of 40 patients (6 cTHA and 34 rTHA) who underwent THA with a fully porous titanium acetabular cup and cemented XLPE liner. Data were collected on demographics, surgical information, outcomes, including osseointegration and migration and implant survivorship. RESULTS: On average, patients were 71.42 ± 9.97 years old and obese (BMI: 30.36 ± 6.88 kg/m2) and were followed up for a mean time of 2.21 ± 0.77 years. Six patients underwent cTHA and 34 patients underwent rTHA. The mean hospital length of stay was 5.34 ± 3.34 days. Three (7.5%) 90-day readmissions were noted. Harris Hip Scores improved, on average, from 53.87 ± 12.58 preoperatively to 83.53 ± 12.15 postoperatively (P<0.001). One case of acetabular shell aspetic loosening with migration was noted. Thirty-nine of the 40 acetabular components were fully osseointegrated without migration. Two patients underwent re-revision surgery for PJI and one patient received acetabular shell+liner re-revision due to aseptic loosening. Kaplan-Meier analysis showed an all-cause revision-free survival rate of 95.0% at 6 months and 1 year, and 92.0% at 4-years. Aseptic acetabular cup, liner dislocation/loosening, and fracture-free survival was 100% at 6 months and 1-year, and 97.1% at 2 years. CONCLUSION: The combined use of a novel 3D-printed fully porous titanium acetabular shell and cemented XLPE acetabular liner yielded excellent rates of osseointegration, and all-cause and acetabular aseptic loosening survivorship at a minimum 1-year follow-up. Further long-term studies are needed to assess the longevity of this construct.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是关于3D打印多孔钛杯的临床研究，未涉及力学性能测试或应力屏蔽量化，与用户关注的AM生物医学材料力学研究关联较弱。

summary_zh.motivation: 评估3D打印多孔钛杯在复杂和翻修髋关节置换中的临床效果。
summary_zh.method: 多中心回顾性研究40例患者，随访至少1年。
summary_zh.result: 骨整合率97.5%，4年无翻修生存率92%。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访与影像学评估。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the clinical outcomes of a novel 3D-printed fully porous titanium acetabular cup with cemented XLPE liner in complex and revision THA.
summary_en.method: Multicenter retrospective review of 40 patients (6 complex, 34 revision) followed for mean 2.2 years.
summary_en.result: Excellent osseointegration (97.5%) and aseptic loosening-free survival (97.1% at 2 years).
summary_en.validation: Clinical outcomes, radiographic assessment of osseointegration, and Kaplan-Meier survivorship analysis.
